I recently had the pleasure of dining at Falafel Al Akawi, an Arabic hotel known for its delectable cuisine. From the moment I walked in, the inviting aroma of freshly prepared dishes set the stage for an exceptional culinary experience.

The highlight of my visit was undoubtedly their falafel fries and hummus. The falafel fries were crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, bursting with flavor in every bite. Paired with their creamy, rich hummus, it was a match made in gastronomic heaven.

Their wraps were another standout. Each wrap was generously filled with a variety of fresh ingredients, perfectly balanced in taste and texture. The authenticity of their food was evident in every dish I tried.

The menu is extensive, offering a wide range of traditional Egyptian and Arabic delicacies. Whether you're craving mezze or wraps Falafel Al Akawi delivers with impressive quality and taste.

The staff were friendly and attentive, enhancing the overall experience. They are warm and welcoming, making it a perfect spot for casual takeout meals.

Falafel Al Akawi is a must-visit for anyone looking to indulge in authentic and mouthwatering Arabic cuisine. Highly recommended!

There is no dine-in. Their falafel are very tasty. We tried the falafel sandwich, the portion is small, but it's good if you are not very hungry. Otherwise, get 2 sandwiches. It's a very affordable place.
